SK02-q01-bihwd4: Encroachments are one of the 4 scored items: crossing boundaries.
Pull-ups are one of the 4 scored items; too many count as errors.
SK02-q02-osmibm: Checking mirrors is not an encroachment; an encroachment is touching or crossing a line or cone.
Getting out to check position is a look, not an encroachment.
SK02-q03-3266hw: Just stopping without changing direction is not a pull-up; you must pull forward.
Opening the door to check position counts as a look, not a pull-up.
SK02-q04-tqsjcx: A pull-up needs a change of direction, driving forward; a pause alone is not one.
An encroachment is touching a line or cone, not stopping.
SK02-q05-lrl1oy: Initial pull-ups are not penalized; only an excessive number count as errors.
Pull-ups are counted; too many of them count as errors.
SK02-q06-valu6a: 1 look is the limit only on straight line backing; other exercises allow 2.
3 is too many; the maximum is 2 looks per exercise.
SK02-q07-rx2mdi: You do get a look on this exercise; straight line backing allows exactly 1.
2 looks is the limit on other exercises; straight line backing allows only 1.
SK02-q08-vkqip5: Leaving it in gear is wrong; put it in Neutral and set the parking brake(s).
A foot on the brake doesn't secure it; you need Neutral and the parking brake(s) set.
SK02-q09-r3lyxt: Climb down facing the vehicle, keeping 3 points of contact the whole time.
Jumping breaks the 3 points of contact rule and can hurt you.
SK02-q10-pqn6pk: Mirror checks are normal backing; a look means leaving your seat, opening the door or walking back.
Stopping without changing direction is the pull-up rule; it is not a look.
SK02-q11-gu1ftg: Not securing the vehicle may be an automatic failure even if it doesn't roll.
It is not just a lost look; failing to secure the vehicle may be an automatic failure.
SK02-q12-k3bpl1: Anywhere is not enough; the rear must be within 3 feet of the back and the vehicle straight.
Touching a line is an encroachment; stop within 3 feet without touching lines or cones.
SK02-q13-8m391t: Parallel parking spaces are beside you, not behind; driver side means on your left.
The right-side space is the conventional parallel park; driver side is on your left.
SK02-q14-7j4h9a: Left is the driver side parallel park; conventional is on your right.
Parallel parking spaces are beside you; conventional means on your right.
SK02-q15-xnqcsg: Touching a cone is an encroachment; keep backing until the front passes the first set of cones.
Half in is not finished; the front of the vehicle must be past the first set of cones.
SK02-q16-pn90yo: Backup cameras cannot be the only thing you use; the test checks your own judgment.
The rule doesn't require covering it; the camera just can't be used alone.
SK02-q17-w641mz: The examiner doesn't swap in an easier exercise; refusing may be an automatic failure.
Refusing is not just a point loss; it may be an automatic failure.
SK02-q18-c2nm50: Final position is scored separately from cones; missing it is penalized and could fail you.
There is no free redo; missing the final position is penalized.
SK02-q19-vye6se: The cab alone is not enough; the entire vehicle must be completely inside the space.
The cab sticking out means not finished; the whole vehicle must be inside.
SK02-q20-0ym0dx: No angle is allowed; the alley dock ends with the vehicle straight in the alley.
Passing the first cones is how the offset back ends; the alley dock ends straight, within 3 feet of the back.
